title: Golden Crown bouncers
summary: Make trouble in the casino and a bouncer will carry you out over one shoulder and throw you into the metro.
notes: Post three buff Golden Crown security guards around the main hall, arms crossed.
Send the nearest guard when someone tries to fire a gun, punches or kicks a guest, sprays graffiti or picks a fight with security in the hall.
Hold the troublemaker in place, sling them over the guard's shoulder, carry them to the casino metro elevator and throw them in.
Drop thrown-out players on a random metro platform; take any metro elevator back to the Crown.
